name: Tosco Salami
source:
It should be a simple job: stock the shelves, help customers, survive until lunch break. But when a strange girl starts asking for Tosco Salami – again and again – you realize something isn’t right.

[From [url=https://guineapigbatman.itch.io/tosco-salami]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这应该是一项简单的工作：上架、帮助顾客、生存到午休时间。但当一个陌生的女孩开始一次又一次地要求托斯科萨拉米香肠时，你就会意识到有些事情不对劲。

[来自[url=https://guineapigbatman.itch.io/tosco-salami]Itch.io[/url]]
